title.zh: 将奎松市菲律宾儿科医院与发育中心恢复名称为菲律宾儿童医疗中心的法案
title.en: An Act Reverting the Name of Philippine Pediatric Hospital and Development Center in Quezon City, to Philippine Children's Medical Center
title.orig: An Act Reverting the Name of Philippine Pediatric Hospital and Development Center in Quezon City, to Philippine Children's Medical Center

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_8018_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Philippine Pediatric Hospital and Development Center in Quezon Boulevard, Quezon City, is hereby reverted to Philippine Children's Medical Center.

Any other law, decree, act, executive order, proclamation, rules and regulations or part thereof inconsistent with any of the provisions of this Act are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
